caption: The drawing consists of a floral arrangement set against a textured gold-colored background. The composition features multiple flower types with varied colors: a large red-pink flower in the upper left, purple and violet flowers towards the upper right, several smaller blue flowers with red centers scattered throughout, and some red-orange flowers lower in the arrangement. Among the flowers, there is a cluster of purple grapes depicted near the lower center. The greenish-blue leaves and stems twist and spread out from a central point, curving around the flowers and grapes. The flowers and leaves show multiple gradients and shades, with highlights and shadows giving a sense of volume to each petal and leaf. The entire arrangement is contained within a slightly off-white border.
title: Detail of Painting on Altar Panel
